items.html: And afterwards, in Gadlut, first the KHB in every edge of the VAK of BaN came, and the KHB in every edge of the VAK of MaH. It is found that already the VAK of ZA were completed, each one of the ten Sefirot of MaH and BaN. Therefore they are called the Mochin of the Gadlut of the VAK, of the names MaH and BaN. And understand this very much.
